## About me

I am a physicist specialising in fluid physics, with a particular
interest in computational modelling and numerical methods.

My recent work has focused on the numerical analysis of
pendant drops with elastic fluid–fluid interfaces, including
inverse parameter estimation and sensitivity analysis.

## Research interests

- Computational physics
- Fluid mechanics and interfacial phenomena
- Numerical modelling and simulation

## Featured project

### PENDROPy

A Python framework for the numerical analysis of pendant
drops with elastic fluid–fluid interfaces.

Developed as part of my Master's thesis, the project
explores the estimation of interfacial elastic parameters
from numerical pendant-drop profiles.
